coverage_gaps: The single available PubMed route may miss pre-indexed historical records, patents, regulatory analyses, conference material, and curated variant annotations outside the biomedical literature.
Query-level retrieval alone may not resolve whether every reported LRRK2 phosphorylation target is an endogenous physiological substrate across tissues and species.
Rare-variant penetrance, ancestry-specific risk, and negative functional results may remain underpowered or affected by publication bias.
Human substantia nigra evidence and longitudinal target-engagement evidence may be sparse, limiting translation from model systems and peripheral pRab10 measurements.
The plan can identify mutation-specific convergence and divergence, while a universal mechanism across monogenic LRRK2 Parkinson disease and idiopathic Parkinson disease may remain unsupported.
exclusion_criteria: Studies mentioning LRRK2 only as part of an untargeted gene list without variant-level or mechanistic analysis.
Non-Parkinson disease studies lacking a direct mechanistic bridge to LRRK2 biology relevant to the framed question.
Substrate claims based solely on overexpression colocalization, interaction, or in vitro phosphorylation without evidence of physiological relevance.
Variant reports lacking interpretable association, segregation, functional, or replication evidence.
Narrative reviews used as sole support for a contested genetic or mechanistic claim.
Drug efficacy studies that do not measure LRRK2 target engagement, substrate response, or a mechanism-relevant endpoint.
Duplicate reports of the same cohort or experiment unless they add independent follow-up, ancestry, penetrance, or mechanistic information.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed-indexed primary human genetic studies, biochemical studies, structural studies, phosphoproteomic studies, cellular studies, or animal studies directly addressing LRRK2 and Parkinson disease mechanism.
Reports published on or before 2024-12-31 with sufficient bibliographic information to identify the experiment and evidence type.
Genetic evidence that reports linkage, segregation, association, ancestry, allele frequency, effect size, or penetrance for a specified LRRK2 variant.
Mechanistic evidence that directly measures LRRK2 kinase activity, GTPase behavior, structure, localization, substrate phosphorylation, or consequences of controlled LRRK2 perturbation.

Substrate claims supported by direct phosphorylation evidence plus at least one orthogonal criterion such as site mapping, kinase dependence, endogenous detection, genetic perturbation, or inhibitor response.

Limiting evidence including incomplete penetrance, mutation-specific divergence, negative results, model or tissue dependence, species differences, off-target concerns, and weak translation to human disease.
Reviews may orient terminology and citation chaining, while mechanistic conclusions must be traced to the underlying primary studies.

queries.purpose: Establish the overall evidence landscape and identify anchor reviews plus primary studies spanning discovery, variants, mechanism, substrates, and limitations.
queries.query: ("Leucine-Rich Repeat Kinase 2"[Mesh] OR LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract]) AND (genetic*[Title/Abstract] OR variant*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR mechanism*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve the linkage, mapping, gene-identification, and early segregation reports needed to trace the genetic discovery chronologically.
queries.query: (PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR segregation[Title/Abstract] OR "positional cloning"[Title/Abstract] OR "autosomal dominant"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover evidence for major high-confidence disease-associated variants, including segregation, pathogenicity, phenotype, and penetrance.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR pathogenic*[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR segregation[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture lower-effect, population-enriched, founder, and ancestry-dependent associations that qualify the generality of variant conclusions.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract] OR "risk variant"[Title/Abstract] OR "population-specific"[Title/Abstract] OR founder[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR ancestry[Title/Abstract] OR ethnicity[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Define the multidomain enzymatic model, including kinase regulation, Roc-COR GTPase behavior, oligomerization, and structural coupling.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR "Roc GTPase"[Title/Abstract] OR "COR domain"[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract] OR dimerization[Title/Abstract]) AND (mechanism*[Title/Abstract] OR structure*[Title/Abstract] OR biochem*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Compare mutation-specific biochemical effects and test whether all pathogenic variants support one shared gain-of-kinase-function mechanism.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract]) AND ("kinase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTP hydrolysis"[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify physiological substrate candidates and prioritize Rab phosphorylation findings supported by unbiased discovery and orthogonal validation.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR Rab35[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Trace organelle recruitment and upstream activation models while distinguishing regulators or recruiters from direct physiological substrates.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR RAB7L1[Title/Abstract] OR lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR Golgi[Title/Abstract] OR membrane*[Title/Abstract]) AND (recruit*[Title/Abstract] OR activat*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR trafficking[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Connect enzymatic and substrate evidence to downstream cellular processes implicated in Parkinson disease without treating pathway association as proof of causality.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND ("endolysosomal trafficking"[Title/Abstract] OR autophagy[Title/Abstract] OR mitochondri*[Title/Abstract] OR ciliogenesis[Title/Abstract] OR "innate immunity"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Assess translation of the kinase-substrate model into human carriers, sporadic disease, tissue samples, and candidate target-engagement biomarkers.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND ("patient-derived"[Title/Abstract] OR "human brain"[Title/Abstract] OR monocyte*[Title/Abstract] OR neutrophil*[Title/Abstract] OR urine[Title/Abstract] OR "extracellular vesicle"[Title/Abstract]) AND (phospho-Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR pRab10[Title/Abstract] OR "kinase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve null, conflicting, model-dependent, toxicity, rescue, and perturbation evidence that constrains causal strength and therapeutic generalization.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (knockout[Title/Abstract] OR "loss of function"[Title/Abstract] OR overexpression[Title/Abstract] OR "kinase inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR contradictory[Title/Abstract] OR dispensable[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR neurodegeneration[Title/Abstract] OR phenotype*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture late evidence through the as-of date, then use newly identified terminology and citations to check whether the mechanistic account or its limitations changed.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract]) AND (variant*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab[Title/Abstract] OR mechanism*[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: What source-backed evidence connects LRRK2 to Parkinson disease from PARK8 linkage and gene discovery through pathogenic and risk variants, mutation-specific effects on Roc-COR GTPase and kinase activity, validated physiological substrates, downstream cellular phenotypes, and human disease observations; and which penetrance, heterogeneity, model-dependence, substrate-validation, and contradictory findings limit the proposed mechanism?
stop_rules: Stop the genetic-discovery wave after the original linkage and gene-identification reports are found and later sources add no new discovery milestone.

Stop variant expansion after each major pathogenic variant class and major population-enriched risk-variant class has at least one primary genetic source, with penetrance or ancestry uncertainty recorded where available.
Stop mechanism retrieval after kinase, Roc-COR GTPase, structural coupling, localization, and mutation-specific effects are each represented by primary evidence and one challenge source.
Stop substrate retrieval only after direct endogenous evidence, perturbation dependence, and physiological-context evidence have been sought for the leading Rab substrates.
Stop each citation chain after two successive relevant sources introduce no new variant, substrate, mechanism, evidence type, limitation, or terminology.
Stop the challenge wave after every central causal claim has at least one targeted search for null, contradictory, mutation-specific, model-dependent, or human-translation evidence.
Stop the update wave when the 2020-2024 date-bounded search and backward citation checks yield no unresolved evidence category within the as-of boundary.
Stop globally at 12 query events and report remaining uncertainties in coverage_gaps rather than exceeding the query budget.
